data.name: Amper
data.description:
[Amper](https://github.com/JetBrains/amper) is a project configuration and build tool with a focus on usability and IDE support.
 
See the [project one-pager](https://jetbrains.team/p/amper/documents/a/2XUW4d3gK7bI) for more info.

data.name: IntelliJ IDEA
data.description: It's a harbor for all IntelliJ-based products.

data.name: Komod
data.description: This project aims to manage Java dependencies outside build tools like Gradle, Maven, Ant. The goal is to introduce first-class citizen support for various caches, proxies, and mirrors to save traffic in high-load CI systems. A source of inspiration is the go mod from Golang.
